limitations: walk5/walk6/down保留各自原版；其余19帧采用本轮发型修正。

idle1.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent full-body 2D game sprite.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the first refined idle1 candidate. Input image 2 is the original idle1 used only as a reference for exact face identity, costume, weapon and full-body pose.

Make one targeted further correction to the twin ponytail design in image 1: the far-side ponytail currently looks like an unexplained dangling hair lump beside the face. Explicitly show its small red tie at its high root on the far right edge of the skull, just behind the upper right bangs, at a similar height to the near-side ponytail tie. It must be visible above the eye/temple level, not hang below the chin. Connect this red tie to a narrow tapered far-side tail behind the head, with a simple smooth continuous outer curve. Reduce the far-side tail's thickness and volume by another 35%, end it just above shoulder level. Remove the long red tassel currently hanging next to the jaw; replace it with one very short red ribbon at that high tie root. Keep the existing reduced near-side ponytail, but shorten its red tie tassel to about half its current length. Remove the long curl hanging onto the exposed chest; retain one short neat cheek-side lock ending near the jaw. Both ponytails must remain clearly recognizable distinct tied tails, not buns.

Keep absolutely everything else in image 1 unchanged: face identity and expression, face and head scale, head orientation, anatomy, body shape and proportions, pose, all clothes, hands, sword, scabbard, feet, canvas framing, character size and position, and soft hand-painted anime style. No wisps, no floating curved strands, no new ornaments. Output a single full-body sprite with genuinely transparent background, clean opaque character interior and antialiased alpha only at boundaries.
